originalTitle: Nasdaq lags on angst over AI spending ahead of earnings reports
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks ended mixed on Friday, with the Dow gaining just under half a percent, the S&P 500 virtually flat and the tech-heavy Nasdaq sliding nearly two-thirds of a percent. The S&P 500 technology index underperformed the broader market as chip stocks fell, with Intel dropping nearly 8% despite forecasting quarterly profit and revenue above Wall Street estimates. Enthusiasm for the AI trade weakened after Alphabet's announcement earlier this week of a plan to hike capital spending even as it burns cash. Richard Reyle, chief investment officer at Questar Capital Partners, said that as a result investors are rotating into what he called "safer parts of the market." "Pharmaceuticals have been flying, and that's been, I think, where we see the rotation of the market right now. [FLASH] You look at the iShares, pharmaceutical fund, it's big components that are J&J and Eli Lilly, they're at all-time highs. And they're still relatively not super expensive stocks. So I think that's a place that can be bought and held. And of course, energy. Exxon's going to announce earnings next week. I bet they're going to be a blockbuster and they're going to continue to be because they make money at $60 a barrel. At $100 a barrel, forget about it. They do very well." The S&P 500 real estate sector also outperformed during the session. Its leading gainer was Digital Realty Trust, which rallied 11% after it raised its full-year forecast for funds from operations. Among other gainers, shares of SLB climbed 11% after the oilfield services firm beat expectations for second-quarter profit. Investors now turn their attention to quarterly results next week from Magnificent 7 megacaps Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Apple.

chineseTitle: 财报发布前，纳斯达克因 AI 支出的担忧而落后
chineseSummary: 故事：美国股市周五收盘涨跌不一，道琼斯指数上涨近半个百分点，标准普尔 500 指数基本持平，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌近三分之二。由于芯片股下跌，标准普尔 500 科技指数跑输大盘，尽管英特尔预测季度利润和营收高于华尔街预期，但其股价仍下跌近 8%。在 Alphabet 本周早些时候宣布计划在烧钱的同时增加资本支出后，人们对人工智能行业的热情有所减弱。 Questar Capital Partners 首席投资官理查德·雷尔 (Richard Reyle) 表示，投资者正转向他所谓的“市场中更安全的部分”。 “医药股一直在飞速发展，我认为这就是我们现在看到的市场轮动的地方。[快闪]你看看 iShares，医药基金，它是强生和礼来公司的重要组成部分，它们处于历史新高。而且它们仍然相对不是超级昂贵的股票。所以我认为这是一个可以购买和持有的地方。当然，还有能源。埃克森美孚下周将宣布收益。我打赌他们将成为重磅炸弹，并且将继续如此，因为他们以每桶 60 美元的价格赚钱，别管它了，他们做得很好。”标准普尔 500 指数房地产板块在盘中也表现出色。涨幅居前的是 Digital Realty Trust，该公司上调全年运营资金预测后股价上涨 11%。在其他上涨股中，油田服务公司 SLB 的第二季度利润超出预期，股价上涨 11%。投资者现在将注意力转向下周微软、亚马逊、Meta 和苹果等七大巨头的季度业绩。
